description: Agent Output Protocol (AOP) - Controls how agents return results to preserve context window
rules: Agents MUST return max 500 characters inline to the orchestrator
Detailed output (code, analysis, logs) goes to DETAILS_FILE on disk
Status must be one of: SUCCESS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, FAILED
SUMMARY must be 2-3 sentences max describing what was accomplished
FILES_MODIFIED is a flat list of changed file paths
ISSUES lists any problems encountered (blockers, warnings)
DETAILS_FILE path is returned so orchestrator can read if needed

returnTemplate.SUMMARY: 2-3 sentence description of what was accomplished

actions.atNormal: Prefer agent delegation over direct work
actions.atParallel: ONLY use background agents, summary-only returns
actions.atCritical: Checkpoint to .claude-session.md, recommend /compact or fresh session
